parts.name: Mirror
parts.Basic_description: This is a flat glass mirror mounted on the front of the cabinet, framed with a metallic or wooden border.
parts.Functional_description: The mirror provides reflective functionality for grooming or visual checking, commonly used in bathroom or dressing cabinets.
parts.Movement_description: The mirror itself is fixed and does not move, though it may be part of a door that swings open.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the outer box.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the mirror and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is stationary and does not move; it serves as the fixed base for other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is a horizontal wooden panel inside the cabinet used for placing or organizing items.
parts.Functional_description: The shelf supports stored objects such as toiletries, medicines, or decorative items, dividing the cabinet space efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: The shelf is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
